verified: Initialization performs no worker/model invocation; native configuration, implementation and binary hashes are frozen.

R=1 synthetic fixture with10 tasks and per-task2 modelcalls yields62 conservative transport ceiling:20 evaluations*(2 executor+1 judge)+1 evolve+1 select. Matching evaluate-digest/evolve-H0/select operation cache entries deduct3/1/1; uncompleted operations reject.
Insufficient authorized headroom stops before stage execution. Ledger remains final shared per-call authorization; preflight is not a reservation or dollar/credit estimate.
Pending review stops before evolve. Repeated advance without approval executes no second stage for the cached task. Bound synthetic approvals advance one next task at a time.
Injected pending-template preparation failure occurs after the paid-result cache is complete; next advance recreates template without rerunning stage. Template is not an approval.

Full synthetic R=1 lifecycle completes20 stages, one evolve and one selection. Finished resume calls no additional stage and reports zero remaining transport ceiling. No real research improvement inferred.
Configuration/implementation/binary changes stop before worker. Private review store cannot overlap builder staging.

Builder callbacks assert no hidden-task identity/controller path/private canary and only receive staged public inputs/evidence. Real public projection retainspublic program checks but excludes private checks.

findings.initial_issue: NativeDevelopmentBuilder constructor accepted cpus0/memory-1/pids0 although CLI said constructor validated resources.
findings.root_fix: Calls shared resource_args(resources) before any container/model action.
findings.current_observation: The same invalid fixture now raises ProtocolError Missing/invalid explicit package resource cpus.

findings.issue: Writing pending template inside paid evaluate callback could mark a successfully completed paid evaluation unresolved after a template failure.
findings.current_observation: Template generation now happens after cached completion and PendingEvaluationReview; failures return template_errors without overwriting operation.

limitations: This proves control-flow integration with synthetic workers, not actual native model behavior, OS isolation, science scores or research evolution.

CLI intentionally requires enough remaining calls for the whole conservative bound, so even a pending-review resume may be blocked by insufficient remaining headroom; no credit purchase or limit expansion is inferred.
Hash binding covers configured source/code/binary/material inputs, not all external Python/Docker/host dependency behavior. Cross-host and actual native checks remain separate.
Shared ledger can be consumed by concurrent work after preflight; per-call ledger checks prevent unauthorized new calls but completion of whole run is not reserved.
Current two real paper packages still cannot supply independent paper-disjoint full five-type search and test coverage; synthetic fixture does not resolve the material gap.
Unknown paid outcomes remain a deliberate stop, not automatic replay; reviewer approvals are explicit trusted controller evidence rather than self-certified model output.
verdict: Nine zero-model cross-module CLI tests passed; identified resource/template issues fixed. Concrete development wiring ready for separately authorized real smoke with adequate materials and review, not formal benchmark acceptance.
